Method of Attack: Malware distributed via malformed APKs to evade detection
APK files trick victims into disclosing sensitive personal and financial information
Use of invisible UI trick to fool users

Exploitation of risky permissions such as RECEIVE_SMS, READ_SMS, BIND_Notifications, Accessibility to intercept OTPs, read sensitive messages, dismiss notifications, monitor user actions, input keystrokes, and execute commands remotely
Internet-sideloading of APKs from unvetted third-party sites
Social engineering lures to convince targets to download malicious apps from external sources
